# Himanshu Bisoyi – Freelance Website Developer

> Himanshu Bisoyi is a freelance website developer based in Madhapur, Hyderabad, India, and a Senior Software Engineer at ISKCON Bangalore. He has more than 4 years of experience and has delivered 150+ websites for clients in India, the USA, Australia, Canada and the UAE. He builds business websites, company websites, e-commerce stores (WooCommerce and Shopify) and landing pages, and offers ongoing maintenance.

## Services and starting prices (INR)
- Landing page: ₹15,000
- Business website (up to 8 pages): from ₹35,000
- Company website (up to 20 pages, blog, admin panel): from ₹60,000
- E-commerce website (WooCommerce or Shopify, payments, customer accounts, order tracking): from ₹1,00,000
- Maintenance: ₹24,000 per year after the free maintenance period
- Payment terms: 50% advance, 50% before launch; the client owns the domain, hosting and website

## Skills
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Figma, Photoshop, SEO foundations.
